name: Divine Communion, Other
body:
School divination; Level cleric/oracle 6

CASTING

Components V, S, M (5,000 gp worth of sacrifices), DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one person
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell is similar to divine communion, except that you may designate another person for your deity to speak through, thus allowing you to participate in the conversation (if any).
